summary: Learning-map growth is no longer a black box. (1) Exploration is visible: the exploration share starts at 20% (was 10%, which gave 0 slots in the first batch), an exploration slot goes first to a paper of a forming new direction (kind explore_new, stored in the existing exposures route columns, no migration), and cards/Today say so. (2) The learning-map page lists the potential directions on arrival (watch and ready, at most 5) as ghost nodes with a progress outline that becomes a solid line when the four gates are met; the side panel shows the gates, what is missing, the papers (which ones the reader marked), sources and where it would sit; only a ready direction can be added. Ghost nodes are display-only and never enter the saved draft. (3) Nodes are understandable: concepts carry an optional intro (<=90 chars) with intro_by user|ai; the plan prompts also ask for a <=30-char intro per concept; a new gateway operation concept_intro writes one sentence per click (never auto-saved, 20 per project per day); read-only actions list the project's papers that match a node and (on click) a few public papers for its first search term. A model draft never overwrites an introduction the person wrote.
scope_note: Branch feature/route-growth-visible (worktree .claude/worktrees/growth), after 0d65548. Not merged into main; the other session's 'understood only in the library / must be saved' rule is not in this branch yet.

budget_impact.rationale: Exploration steering, ghost nodes, matched papers and the progress outline are local and deterministic: zero tokens. Model-facing changes: learning_path_plan and learning_path_plan_project input cap 1400->1460 and output cap 900->1500 (reference output 700->1100) for one intro per concept; new operation concept_intro (input 500, output 250, 20 paid attempts per project per local day in App.CONCEPT_INTROS_PER_DAY, one at a time per project) sending only the concept name (30 chars), up to two search terms (30 chars each) and the project name plus first three keywords (80 chars together). The owner approved the plan raises and the new operation in the session on 2026-10-06 (AskUserQuestion answer: 起草学习图时一起写简介,新增“写这个节点的简介”操作). The independent review found the disclosed field was called 'project goal' although projects have no goal field and that the 500-token estimate was exceeded (516) at the earlier limits; the wording was corrected everywhere and the limits tightened (30/80, worst case 471 by the 1.5 tokens-per-character heuristic). Neither prompt has had a real call.
budget_impact.before: learning_path_plan(_project): cap 1400/900, reference output 700; no concept_intro
budget_impact.after: learning_path_plan(_project): cap 1460/1500, reference output 1100; concept_intro: cap 500/250, reference 300/120

open_risks: concept_intro and the intro field of the plan prompts have never had a real model call: output quality and length are unknown; every number is a conservative estimate.
The 20% exploration share is a tuning choice without data.
Steering exploration with two-paper 'watch' directions can pick generic phrases; they are limited to five and labelled as weak evidence, but real libraries were not measured.
The review fixes were not re-read by a reviewer.
Not merged with main: the other session's 'understood needs a saved paper' rule will break test fixtures here that mark unsaved papers understood.
New error messages raised as ValueError (e.g. 正在写简介，请稍候) have no English entry, like the existing ones.
The Tauri window was not clicked through.
